label.purpose: Form labels, a group's legend, the brand, the pressed pause button and form errors: 600, 1rem.

mono.purpose: Only for text a person copies into a terminal, such as a new API token.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Every focusable element; CanvasText under forced colors.

motion.name: progress-fill-ease
motion.purpose: A progress fill slides in from the track's start to each report, its round end leading, never resizing; under reduced motion it jumps.

motion.name: change-mark-settle
motion.purpose: A live table row's change mark arrives lit in Margin Wash and settles back to the cells' own fill; a color fade, so it stays under reduced motion, and 600 ms is the longest any kept fade runs.

motion.name: tooltip-fade-in
motion.purpose: A tooltip fades in; kept under reduced motion, since a fade moves nothing.

motion.name: tooltip-fade-out
motion.purpose: A tooltip fades out; kept under reduced motion.

motion.name: spinner-turn
motion.purpose: The spinner's arc turns once in 0.9 s; under reduced motion it is not drawn and three still dots stand in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition-property: opacity, color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color, fill, stroke, display, overlay, visibility; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Decision 130: under prefers-reduced-motion nothing moves, resizes, rotates, scales or loops; only a fade of a color or the opacity stays, 600 ms at most. The rule sits in the first cascade layer, as important, so no component can turn it off.

breakpoints.name: repositories-container
breakpoints.purpose: Container query on the repositories table's frame: column widths switch from fixed shares to what each column holds.

breakpoints.name: operations-container
breakpoints.purpose: Container query on the operations table's frame: column widths switch from fixed shares to what each column holds.

breakpoints.name: tabs-responsive-container
breakpoints.purpose: Container query on a responsive tab list's own space: a column beside the panel above it, a wrapping row below.

breakpoints.name: steps-container
breakpoints.purpose: Container query on the steps' own container: a row above it, a column below.

breakpoints.name: page-width-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Settings' Narrow page width, the default, centers main at up to 60rem; Full width uses the window's width. Each paragraph and form stays at up to 70ch.

breakpoints.name: dialog-max
breakpoints.purpose: A native dialog is as wide as its content up to 48rem.

components.name: Filled Button

components.name: Ghost Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; box-sizing: border-box; min-block-size: 2em; padding-block: 0; padding-inline: 0.75em; border: 1px solid var(--tone); border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; cursor: pointer; font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-ghost { --tone: var(--muted, #4b5563); --tone-hover: var(--muted-hover, #374151); background-color: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: var(--tone); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: var(--surface, #f3f4f6); color: var(--tone-hover); } .ds-btn-ghost[aria-pressed="true"] { border: 2px inset var(--tone); padding-inline: calc(0.75em - 1px); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Unavailable Button

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; box-sizing: border-box; min-block-size: 2em; padding-block: 0; padding-inline: 0.75em; border: 1px solid var(--tone); border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; cursor: pointer; font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-outlined { --tone: var(--muted, #4b5563); background-color: transparent; color: var(--tone); } .ds-btn[aria-disabled="true"] { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Error Button
components.description: Error tone for an action that deletes or takes away; Filled only as a dialog's confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; box-sizing: border-box; min-block-size: 2em; padding-block: 0; padding-inline: 0.75em; border: 1px solid var(--tone); border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; cursor: pointer; font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-error { --tone: var(--error, #b91c1c); --tone-hover: var(--error-hover, #991b1b); background-color: transparent; color: var(--tone); } .ds-btn-error:hover { background-color: var(--surface, #f3f4f6); border-color: var(--tone-hover); color: var(--tone-hover); }

components.name: Link
components.description: A native link: Ladder Blue, always underlined (thicker under the pointer), no visited color; the current page is bold; a link to another site says so in words and ends in the ExternalLink icon.
components.html: See the restore guide, the current page or the rustic manual (goes to another site).
components.css: .ds-text { margin: 0; font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); } .ds-link { color: var(--accent, #1d4ed8); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: max(1px, 0.0625em); text-underline-offset: 0.25em; text-decoration-skip-ink: auto; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: max(2px, 0.125em); } .ds-link[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 700; } .ds-link > .ds-icon { margin-inline-start: 0.25em; vertical-align: -0.125em; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-sr { position: absolute; inline-size: 1px; block-size: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Alert

components.html: Error: The repository could not be reached. Check the address and try again.

components.name: Banner
components.description: A page-wide notice above a page's content: a square Ledger Gray strip, tone in its icon and a 0.25rem start edge. Primary (information) or Warning only; never a red banner. Dismiss is an optional Ghost Small X.
components.html: Warning: Ladderback needs Full Disk Access to back up this machine's folders.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.5rem; margin-block: 0.5rem; padding-block: 0.5rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem; background-color: var(--surface, #f3f4f6); color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); border: 0; border-inline-start: 0.25rem solid var(--tone); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-banner-icon { display: flex; flex: none; align-items: center; min-block-size: 1lh; color: var(--tone); } .ds-banner-words { flex: 1 1 min-content; min-inline-size: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-banner-warning { --tone: var(--warning, #b45309); } .ds-dismiss { flex: none; margin-inline-start: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; inline-size: 1.75em; block-size: 1.75em; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #4b5563); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; } .ds-dismiss:hover { background-color: var(--surface, #f3f4f6); color: var(--muted-hover, #374151); } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-sr { position: absolute; inline-size: 1px; block-size: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; }

components.html: Pending changes 3

components.html: Succeeded with warnings
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 0.25em; max-inline-size: 100%; padding-block: 0.125rem; padding-inline: 0.5rem; border-radius: calc(0.5lh + 0.125rem); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-icon { display: flex; flex: none; align-self: flex-start; align-items: center; min-block-size: 1lh; } .ds-badge-words { flex: 1 1 min-content; min-inline-size: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-badge { color: inherit; outline: 1px solid currentColor; outline-offset: -1px; } } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-badge-warning { color: var(--warning-fg, #451a03); background-color: var(--warning-bg, #fde68a); }

components.name: Status Badge: Running

components.html: Running
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 0.25em; max-inline-size: 100%; padding-block: 0.125rem; padding-inline: 0.5rem; border-radius: calc(0.5lh + 0.125rem); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-icon { display: flex; flex: none; align-self: flex-start; align-items: center; min-block-size: 1lh; } .ds-badge-words { flex: 1 1 min-content; min-inline-size: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-badge { color: inherit; outline: 1px solid currentColor; outline-offset: -1px; } } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-badge-primary { color: var(--badge-loading-fg, #172554); background-color: var(--badge-loading-bg, #dbeafe); }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Views within one page, horizontal: tabs on one Slate Note rule, no fill or box; the selected tab is bold with a 3 px Ladder Blue bar on the rule, a hovered one shows a Slate Note line as thick as the bar. A hidden bold copy keeps each tab as wide selected as not.
components.html: Choose how wide pages are in this browser.
components.css: .ds-tabs { color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: 0.25rem; border-block-end: 1px solid var(--muted, #4b5563); } .ds-tab { min-block-size: 1.5rem; margin-block-end: -1px; padding-block: 0.25rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem; border: 0; border-block-end: 1px solid var(--muted, #4b5563); background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { padding-block-end: calc(0.25rem - 2px); border-block-end: 3px solid var(--accent, #1d4ed8); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab:hover { padding-block-end: calc(0.25rem - 2px); border-block-end-width: 3px; } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]:hover { border-block-end-color: var(--accent, #1d4ed8); } .ds-tab-label { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-tab-label::after { content: attr(data-label); block-size: 0; overflow: hidden; visibility: hidden; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab-panel { padding-block: 0.75rem; } .ds-tab-panel > p { margin: 0; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A native input drawn from the tokens: 1 px Field Edge, one small corner, flat on the page's background, a Medium button's height, full line width up to 32rem; label above in Label weight with "(required)" in words, its description under it. Invalid takes a 2 px Red Ink edge.
components.html: What this machine is called in Ladderback.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-block: 1rem; color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field-note { margin-block: 0.25rem; } .ds-input { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 32rem; min-block-size: 2em; margin: 0; margin-block-start: 0.25rem; padding-block: 0; padding-inline: 0.75em; border: 1px solid var(--field-edge, #6b7280); border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); background-color: var(--bg, #ffffff); color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: inherit; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-width: 2px; border-color: var(--error, #b91c1c); padding-inline: calc(0.75em - 1px); } .ds-input[readonly] { border-style: dashed; } .ds-input:disabled { background-color: var(--surface, #f3f4f6); color: var(--muted, #4b5563); cursor: not-allowed; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A native checkbox drawn from the tokens: a box never under 24 px and 1.5 times the text, a 1 px Field Edge round Paper with the small corner; chosen, edge and fill in Ladder Blue under a check in Paper. Its label is Label weight, its description under it.
components.html: Runs even when the laptop is unplugged.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 0.5rem; align-items: start; margin-block: 1rem; color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-box { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; appearance: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; inline-size: max(24px, 1.5em); block-size: max(24px, 1.5em); border: 1px solid var(--field-edge, #6b7280); background-color: var(--bg, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-box:checked { border-color: var(--accent, #1d4ed8); background-color: var(--accent, #1d4ed8); } .ds-box:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice label { justify-self: start; font-weight: 600; } .ds-choice p { grid-column: 2; margin-block: 0.25rem; } .ds-box-square { border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); } .ds-mark { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; display: none; pointer-events: none; color: var(--bg, #ffffff); } .ds-box:checked + .ds-mark { display: block; } .ds-icon { flex: none; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Radio Group
components.description: A group of native radios named by its legend: round, a 1 px Field Edge round Paper; chosen, edge and fill in Ladder Blue under a dot in Paper (max(10px, 0.625em)).
components.html: Page width
components.css: .ds-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 0.5rem; align-items: start; margin-block: 1rem; color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-box { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; appearance: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; inline-size: max(24px, 1.5em); block-size: max(24px, 1.5em); border: 1px solid var(--field-edge, #6b7280); background-color: var(--bg, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-box:checked { border-color: var(--accent, #1d4ed8); background-color: var(--accent, #1d4ed8); } .ds-box:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice label { justify-self: start; font-weight: 600; } .ds-choice p { grid-column: 2; margin-block: 0.25rem; } .ds-group { margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; } .ds-group legend { padding: 0; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg, #1b1f24); font: 1rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-group .ds-choice { margin-block: 0.5rem; } .ds-box-round { border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-dot { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; display: none; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 9999px; inline-size: max(10px, 0.625em); block-size: max(10px, 0.625em); background-color: var(--bg, #ffffff); } .ds-box:checked + .ds-dot { display: block; }

components.name: Toast

narrative.overview:
Ladderback's web UI is a ledger of backups: ruled rows of facts, each with its unit, read top to bottom. A page is a heading, a sentence that says where things stand, and a table or a form. The person comes to check that every machine is backed up, notice the one that isn't, and act; nothing on the page competes with that.

The look is plain, on purpose. Headings and dialogs are the browser's native controls, and a button, a text field, a checkbox and a radio are native elements drawn from the tokens, so they look the same in every browser while they behave the way the reader's browser, zoom, high-contrast mode and screen reader expect. All are sized to the text around them. Surfaces are flat. One blue carries links, focus, progress, a chosen checkbox or radio and a row's main action, three status hues tell what went well, what needs a look and what failed, always beside words, and quiet pairs, dark words on a pale fill (pale on deep in dark mode), say what a run is doing. Everything else is text.

Accessibility shapes the layout rather than decorating it: every layout holds at 320 px wide with text at 200 %, in both directions of writing, in light, dark and forced colors.
keyCharacteristics: Native controls underneath, buttons, fields and choices drawn from the tokens, flat surfaces, no shadows.
One accent, Ladder Blue, for action: links, the focus ring, progress and a row's one Filled button. Three status hues beside it, never alone.
State is a labeled badge with an icon, never color alone.
Tables with one muted rule per row and columns that don't move as rows change.
Logical properties only; layouts follow the page's writing direction.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Ladder Blue is the one accent for action. Beside it stand three status hues, Tick Green, Flag Amber and Red Ink, which never carry a meaning alone: a part drawn in one says it in words or an icon too. Any other new meaning gets words, weight or an icon, not a new hue.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: A color is added as a text-and-background pair with a contrast check in `scripts/check-contrast.ts`, never as a lone value.

rules.name: The Weight Not Color Rule
rules.body: Current, selected and pressed are said by weight (and an inset edge on a pressed button, a bar beside a selected tab), never by color alone.

rules.name: The Reader's Size Rule
rules.body: Form controls inherit the page's font (`font: inherit`), so a button's label doubles when the reader doubles their text.

rules.name: The 320 Rule
rules.body: Every page fits 320 px wide with 200 % text without scrolling sideways. Long words break (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`); a path, address or ID moves to the next line whole before it breaks inside. A data table wider than the page scrolls inside its own frame, never the page.

rules.name: The Logical Rule
rules.body: Margins, padding, sizes and insets use logical properties (`inline-size`, `margin-block`, `inset-inline-start`), never left, right, width or height.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. Separation is a fill, a rule or a heading.

dos: **Do** use the shared components in `crates/web/src/components/` and add new ones to `/_gallery`, each taking its color, size and placement from the shared vocabulary.
**Do** style with Tailwind utilities first, and write custom CSS in `style.css` only for what they can't reasonably express, with a comment saying why (decision 117).
**Do** take colors only from the custom properties in `style.css`, through their Tailwind names (`text-muted`, `bg-surface`), or `var()` in the custom CSS that remains.
**Do** give every state words and an icon or weight as well as its color.
**Do** keep a changing table's columns still: fixed shares, or widths that don't depend on a cell's changing content.
**Do** check a new layout at 320 px with 200 % text, right to left, in dark mode and under forced colors.
donts: **Don't** add dashboard chrome: cards, gradients, glows, shadows or big hero numbers.
**Don't** repeat a failure in red across the page. It is stated once, as an error badge or one alert or error message; no red banners, red rows or red headings.
**Don't** restyle a native control with custom fills, radii or borders outside its shared component: a button's look is `Button`'s.
**Don't** introduce a second accent color, a fourth status hue, or a color without a contrast-checked pair.
**Don't** set text or control sizes in pixels, or use physical properties (`left`, `width`, `margin-top`).

**Don't** animate anything that the reduced-motion rule can't turn off: under reduced motion nothing moves, resizes, rotates, scales or loops, and only a fade of a color or the opacity, 600 ms at most, stays (decision 130).
